subject: general
question: In which state of India is the famous 'Khetri' mine located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The Indian state of **Rajasthan **has the town of **Khetri **Nagar.
 
• It belongs to the **Shekhawati **area.
 
• Two settlements make up **Khetri**:
 
 
• **"Khetri Town,"** established by Raja Khet Singhji Nirwan, and
 
• **"Khetri Nagar,"** located approximately 10 kilometres from Khetri.
 
 
 
• Khetri Nagar was constructed by **Hindustan Copper Limited**, a public sector enterprise run by the Indian government, and is notable for its **Copper Project.**
 
• Another name for** Khetri Nagar **is **"Copper."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• Khetri had** 17,377** residents as of the **2001 India Census.**
 
• The population is made up of **52% **men and** 48% women.**
 
• **Male literacy **is **77%** and **female literacy **is **56%**, making Khetri's average literacy rate higher than the country's average of **59.5% **at **67%.**
 
• **15%** of people in Khetri are **under** the age of **six**.
